structuredContent.goal: Focused interpretive scientific review of an existing development-only mouse motor-cortex recorded-positive-pattern analysis. Determine what a future M2-minus-M1 gain could distinguish about residual pair organization given a small heterogeneous M1-minus-M0 gain, adequate prediction relative to uniform, finite continuous-source adjustment, and unknown observation negatives. Challenge substantive interpretation; preserve the frozen analysis and do not add a new execution gate. No M2 result or null result exists yet. This is advisory scientific review, not formal Society or scientific acceptance.

hints_applied.review_scope: existing aggregate results and frozen specification only; no private cell-level data, sealed data, new experiments, or biological promotion

known_evidence.observations: zeros unknown; fixed observed cardinality; real M2 unopened

preview: Confirm the statistical/analytic specification matches the declared research question.
Verify the design matrix / model structure is well-posed (no rank deficiency, no collinear nuisance regressors).
Random seed is pinned and reported.
Atlas / parcellation version is declared when atlas-based features are used.
The estimand is clearly specified (population, unit, causal vs. associational).
The chosen method is defensible for that estimand, not just conventional.
Synthesize correctness + completeness + judgment into a single overall_decision.

For each axis, produce the required_outputs and pick a decision from decision_space.
Use kg_derived_criteria summaries when present; request include_full_rubric=true if you need the full rubric or JSON schema.
Roll up to overall_decision using the rules under the overall axis.
Submit the completed verdict via submission_tool, echoing directive_id.
